primary_claim: Computing per-token 'unigram' activations from the two-token sequence [<bos>, t] gives far higher cosine similarity to true in-context activations, and lower Tokenized-SAE reconstruction MSE, than using the single token [t] alone, because position-0 activations are dominated by semantics-invariant 'massive activations'.

effect.metric: cosine similarity of unigram activations / minimum SAE reconstruction MSE

quote: all strategies involving 2 or more tokens consistently out-perform [t], including a controlling strategy [<bos>, 37233] which does not include [t] at all
